evals.name: narrate-exit-2-runs-the-check
evals.prompt: /speech:narrate just stopped with exit 2. What is missing?
evals.expected_output: Runs check.py with --data-dir and reports each PASS/FAIL row with the remedy it printed, then offers the fixes without running any.
expectations: Reports every FAIL row with the remedy the script printed
Installs and downloads nothing before the user says yes

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/speech:check

The kokoro-model row failed. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Does not download from this skill; names /speech:setup apply install-model as the route.
expectations: Does not claim the model is now present

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When every row passes, reports the rows and the summary and stops without suggesting setup.
expectations: Reports the rows and the summary line as printed
On all PASS, does not suggest /speech:setup

evals.name: failed-package-row-is-offered-not-run
evals.prompt:
/speech:check

The plugin was enabled a minute ago in this session.
evals.expected_output: When the python-packages row fails, reports it and offers to run the repair line the row printed, and runs nothing until the user answers.
expectations: Offers to run the python-packages repair line exactly as check.py printed it
Runs no install before the user says yes
Does not tell the user to start a new session as the only route

evals.name: yes-runs-the-declared-repair-only
evals.prompt:
/speech:check

The python-packages row failed. Yes, run the repair for me.
evals.expected_output: Runs the repair line check.py printed for python-packages and reports its result; uses no other installer.
expectations: Runs the `pydeps.py install --data-dir` repair line the row printed
Does not run uv, uvx or a bare pip command of its own
